content:
hana_sales: Prospect asked for an EU-only dataflow diagram + subprocessor list showing who touches PII, and a short CAIQ-friendly blurb about encryption/segmentation. Need by tomorrow AM.

derek_presales: I can make a 1-page DFD PNG and a CSV with columns (processor, role, data_classes, region, eu_flag). Clarify: they require no PII backups outside EU?

hana_sales: Correct 7: PII must remain in EU; metrics can be pseudonymized and stored in EU.

derek_presales: OK. For Hosted we'll include a config snippet to pin regions and disable fallback/backups. For Dedicated/Private we'll note VPC-level segmentation and EU-only storage.

maya_security: Add these tech notes: TLS1.2+ in transit; AES-256 at rest; customer-managed KMS supported (EU keys); Redwood HSM available with split-escrow only if contractually required; KV cache ephemeral on Hosted, persistent in EU for Dedicated/Private.

owen_legal: I'll draft a sample DPA clause: "Redwood will notify Customer 30 days prior to onboarding any new subprocessor that may process Customer Data; Customer may reasonably object." Attach when CSV is posted.

derek_presales: Draft Hosted pin snippet to include in the pack:
```yaml
routing:
  allowed_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: false
storage:
  backups_enabled: false
  backup_region: eu-central-1
```

derek_presales: I'll upload DFD + CSV + one-paragraph CAIQ blurb + a pricing bullet (50 RPS: Dedicated ~ +40% vs Hosted) in ~5 hours and drop links here.

hana_sales: Perfect, once uploaded I'll forward to the prospect security contact. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
